title: The ‘Heart of Campus’ Reimagined: Renovation and Expansion Brings New Life to Chapel of Reconciliation
summary_en: On Friday, Sept. 18, Augustana University celebrated the rededication of the Chapel of Reconciliation following the completion of a $4.4 million donor-funded renovation and expansion project — renewing a space that has served as a place for worship, reflection and community for more than four decades.
title_cn: The ‘Heart of Campus’ Reimagined: Renovation and Expansion Brings New Life to Chapel of Reconciliation
